text: With the gap diagnosed, the team makes three permanent changes instead of one quick patch.
A noise-modeled pre-check becomes a required pipeline stage before any future real-hardware run, run first, every time.
Readout error mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation genuinely help the existing results -- but honestly, neither one closes the gap to ideal-simulator performance.
A written hybrid decision rule sets a real trust threshold. Applied to this exact test case, the result doesn't clear it.
The classical baseline remains the production answer today. The quantum run was valuable, honest experimentation -- not yet a production advantage.
